correctness.rationale: The states are six-subsets of the fixed plane, with no quotient by projective automorphisms. Testing every line is equivalent to testing absence of collinear triples. An independent implementation tested all 54,264 candidates, found exactly 168 states, and reproduced the certified SHA-256 02ec2a9578cdf81b7773f1feeda922c745a0e539c8dbce7a8f76e91cd61d3694. It exhausted all 14,028 pairs: overlaps 0 through 3 occurred 840, 6048, 3780 and 3360 times, with the respective common-neighbour counts 4,5,16,11, and overlaps 4 and 5 never occurred. Noncomplete 40-regularity and positive common-neighbour counts for every nonedge give eccentricity two for every vertex; three is the first feasible replacement size. The parity classes have size 56 and cross-degrees 20. The independent integer matrix check reproduced the annihilating polynomial and traces 168,0,6720,73920,3346560. Symmetry and the distinct roots make the multiplicities uniquely determined by the five traces; 3360*11/3 gives 12320 triangles. evidence: Let P be the hyperoval-by-point incidence matrix, M=PP^t, E the same-class all-ones blocks, J the full all-ones matrix, and A the adjacency matrix. Table entries (including diagonal degree) give A^2+6A=6M-J+5E entry by entry.

Each class is invariant under PSL(3,4), which acts 2-transitively on points (map ordered independent representatives and adjust determinant on a third basis vector). Thus each class has point replication 16 and pair replication 4. In total P^tP=36I+12J. The right-hand side of the matrix identity has eigenspaces: constants (1840), class contrasts of dimension 2 (280), zero-sum point indicators of dimension 20 (216), and their orthogonal complement of dimension 145 (0).

A preserves these spaces. On the class quotient zero within-class entries, symmetry and equal row sums 40 force all cross entries 20, giving -20 on contrasts. On point indicators the possible roots are 12 and -18; tr(AM)=3*168*40=20160, of which 288*40 comes from constants, so the trace on the 20-dimensional space is 240. Every such eigenvalue must be 12. The remaining roots are 0 and -6, and tr(A)=0 forces multiplicities 105 and 40. The triangles are 3360*11/3.
